name: clm
description: Replaces compaction for the main conversation: older turns are folded into a ledger (goal, user instructions, done, to do, open questions, key facts) and the transcript is rewritten to the first request, the ledger and the newest turns that fit.

budget.title: Token budget
budget.description: Message tokens allowed before older turns are folded into the ledger; the system prompt and tool schemas are not counted. An integer of at least 2000.

tailTarget.title: Tail target
tailTarget.description: Tokens the first request, the ledger and the kept newest turns may fill after a fold. 0 means half the budget.

reserve.title: Reserve
reserve.description: A fold starts this many tokens before the budget is reached. Must be under the budget. 0 means 2048, or a quarter of a budget under 8192.

model.title: Summarizer model
model.description: Model that folds the older turns into the ledger.

reviewModel.title: Reviewer model
reviewModel.description: Model that audits each fold's claims against their quotes. Empty means the summarizer model.
